summary: NatWest Group plc furnished a Form 6-K carrying a London Stock Exchange announcement of daily purchases under its existing share buyback programme, executed by UBS AG, London Branch under instructions issued 16 February 2026. Over 7-9 October 2026 the company bought roughly 4.79 million ordinary shares at volume-weighted prices of about 640-649 pence (highs to 658p, lows to 636.4p) across LSE, CHIX and BATE. Repurchased shares will be cancelled; treasury holds 177,994,354 shares. Watch execution pace against the programme envelope and any acceleration signals.
